geometry_bands.source_anchor: teleport-strike: the player vanishes and reappears in melee range of a nearby enemy AND lands the hit in one action, then auto-repeats target-to-target while Frenzy Charges last. Physical melee -> element-neutral (physical rule; elem_raw=physical is flavor only). Engine's own derivation rule (physical + teleport-effect -> dash_attack) corroborates dash_attack over teleport (which is the non-physical reposition member). mapping_json.fidelity_notes: CHARGE-CYCLE teleport-striker. Identity = 'spend a Frenzy Charge to bypass cooldown and teleport-strike; sustain charges via kills to hold the loop'. charge_stack_sub_shape=cycle (accumulate-then-spend rhythm, not a pure accumulator) captures the generate/consume treadmill; TEMPORAL_CHARGE is the charge-engine T4 door. PHASE_MOMENTUM as secondary (the repeated blink-reposition reads as phase-cycling movement). Physical rule: physical melee -> element-neutral; Terminus Est / Oro's / Blood Rage are the charge-sustain items (economy lane, not element). The auto-teleport-to-a-RANDOM-nearby-enemy is the signature feel; dash_attack carries the reposition-strike but not the randomness of target selection (a behavioral property). Slayer/Raider variants swap the sustain source (ignite vs frenzy-passive) but keep the identity.
mapping_json.motion_frame: movement-IS-attack: hold one button, the character blinks enemy-to-enemy striking on each arrival; positioning is automatic, the loop is charge-fuelled teleport-strikes

economy: Frenzy-charge cycle: kills/Blood-Rage/Raider generate, each Flicker spends one to bypass the 2s cooldown
